drivers.name: Security, privacy, and regulatory compliance
drivers.description: The system must protect personal, biometric, and payment data and satisfy GDPR, the Privacy Directive, ISO 27001, and local regional standards.
supporting_evidence: Project description requires GDPR and Privacy Directive compliance.
Project description requires ISO 27001 compliance.
Project description requires compliance with local regulations and standards, including EU or China standards, depending on location.
S1 requires secure handling of registration data.
S3 involves biometric login handling.
S8 involves payment data handling.

drivers.name: Time-sensitive rider interactions
drivers.description: The system must handle authentication timing, session timeout, rental expiration notifications, and short-lived verification flows correctly.
supporting_evidence: S2 defines verification code validity and expiration timing.
S3 requires login by credentials or biometric thumb-impression.
S4 requires logout after 15 minutes of inactivity.
S9 requires notification before rental expiry.
S10 defines rental duration limits.

drivers.name: Real-time bike availability and location awareness
drivers.description: The system must keep nearby bike discovery, bike selection, registration, and availability status aligned with current bike state and user proximity needs.
supporting_evidence: S5 requires viewing available bikes by proximity.
S6 requires navigation to a selected bike and registration by scan or code.
S7 requires immediate removal from available bikes after registration.
S12 requires administrator visibility of all bikes as available or under utilization.

drivers.name: Billing and payment handling
drivers.description: The system must support payment processing and additional charges associated with overtime rides.
supporting_evidence: S8 requires payment by bank account or debit/credit card and disallows cash.
S9 states overtime rides are subject to additional charges.

drivers.name: Cross-channel access for riders and administrators
drivers.description: The system must serve both web and mobile users while supporting rider and administrator workflows.
supporting_evidence: Project description states the software should be available on web and mobile devices.
S1 involves rider registration.
S5 and S11 involve rider-facing bike discovery and usage history.
S12 and S13 involve administrator views and usage reporting.

drivers.name: Operational reporting and history retention
drivers.description: The system must retain and expose historical usage data for riders and administrators.
supporting_evidence: S11 requires viewing and downloading usage history up to the last 3 months.
S13 requires hourly and daily bike usage reporting.

drivers.name: External service compatibility
drivers.description: The system must interoperate with external communication and payment services.
supporting_evidence: S2 allows verification code delivery via SMS or email.
Project description requires compatibility with a variety of third-party payment platforms.
S8 requires payment via bank account or debit/credit card.

drivers.name: User experience simplicity
drivers.description: The system must be easy to use for potential riders in routine registration, login, bike discovery, rental, and history tasks.
supporting_evidence: Project description states the software should be user-friendly and easy to use for all potential riders.
S1-S3 cover registration and login.
S5-S6 cover locating and registering a bike.
S8 covers payment.
S11 covers history access.
